items.t: Cracked plastic intake manifold coolant passage (4.6L)
items.job: Replace intake manifold and gaskets
items.note: Cost rises if the engine overheated after the coolant leak.

items.t: Coolant loss into the cylinders (2.3L EcoBoost)
items.job: Replace engine short block
items.note: The block itself is the problem, so head gasket repairs rarely last. Ask a dealer about any goodwill help.

items.t: 10-speed automatic may not hold in Park (2018 recall)
items.job: Inspect transmission and install missing park roll pin (recall remedy)
items.note: Recall 18V-213. Free at a Ford dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: 10-speed automatic may not engage Park (2022-2023 recall)
items.job: Inspect transmission and replace if needed (recall remedy)
items.note: Recall 23V-070. Free at a Ford dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Rear suspension knuckle may have a casting flaw (recall)
items.job: Inspect rear suspension knuckle and replace if needed (recall remedy)
items.note: Recall 24V-593. Free at a Ford dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Clutch line can melt against the exhaust on manual cars (recall)
items.job: Inspect clutch pressure line and repair if needed (recall remedy)
items.note: Recall 24V-394. Free at a Ford dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Engine bay wiring ground can break (recall)
items.job: Replace engine compartment harness ground terminals (recall remedy)
items.note: Recall 26V-547. Ford advises not driving the car until it is fixed. Free at a Ford dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Accelerator pedal can catch on the carpet (Cobra recall)
items.job: Install shield over carpet cutout behind accelerator pedal (recall remedy)
items.note: Recall 06V-108 (2004 Cobra). Free at a Ford dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Timing chain guides wear out on the 4.0L V6
items.job: Replace timing chains, guides and tensioners
items.note: Rear-mounted chain job on the 4.0L V6; engine often has to come out or be lifted.

items.t: Plastic thermostat housing cracks and leaks coolant
items.job: Replace thermostat housing and coolant

items.t: Rear axle pinion seal seeps gear oil
items.job: Replace rear axle pinion seal and refill gear oil

items.t: Front seat belt pretensioner cable can corrode and break (recall)
items.job: Trim carpet, inspect pretensioner cables and replace if corroded (recall remedy)
items.note: Recall 25V-614. Free at a Ford dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Backup camera picture is distorted or missing (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace rear camera or update SYNC software (recall remedy)
items.note: Ford camera recalls (25S89, 25S72). Free at a Ford dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Instrument cluster can come up blank (recall)
items.job: Reprogram instrument cluster (recall remedy)
items.note: Ford recalls 19C03 and 26C27 (NHTSA 26V-372). Free at a Ford dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Reverse lights, camera and driver aids can switch off on manual cars (recall)
items.job: Reprogram powertrain control module (recall remedy)
items.note: Ford recall 22S37. Free at a Ford dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Low brake fluid warning may never appear (recall)
items.job: Update body control module software (recall remedy)
items.note: Recall 23V-727, or 25V-689 for cars that missed the first fix. Free at a Ford dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Steering can turn on its own from a sensor calibration fault (recall)
items.job: Update power steering control module software (recall remedy)
items.note: Recall 24V-493, or 25V-096 for cars repaired incorrectly. Free at a Ford dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Water can knock out the tail and marker lights (recall)
items.job: Check body seam sealing; inspect and replace body control module if wet (recall remedy)
items.note: Recall 25V-546. Free at a Ford dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Headlight driver modules can fail (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace headlamp LED driver modules (recall remedy)
items.note: Recall 25V-519. Free at a Ford dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Wipers may only run on high and washers may not work in the cold (recall)
items.job: Inspect wiper motor and replace if faulty (recall remedy)
items.note: Recall 26V-418. Free at a Ford dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Piston faults can damage the engine (recall)
items.job: Inspect pistons and replace engine long block if affected (recall remedy)
items.note: Recall 26V-205 or 26V-548 (2026 models). Ford advises not driving the car until it is checked. Free at a Ford dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: EGR valve can fail and cut engine power (recall)
items.job: Replace EGR valve (recall remedy)
items.note: Recall 26V-122 (2025 2.3L). Ford advises not driving the car until it is fixed. Free at a Ford dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Spark plug can blow out of the cylinder head
items.job: Repair spark plug threads with a steel insert
items.note: Cost climbs fast if the head has to come off or the ejected plug damaged the coil and boot.

items.t: Fuel pump driver module fails and the car stalls
items.job: Replace fuel pump driver module
items.note: Budget a little extra if the connector is corroded and has to be repaired as well.
